description: Land Acquisition - Beruketiya, Padukka D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring that certain described lands are needed for public purpose and will be acquired. The document provides detailed descriptions of multiple land lots, including their boundaries, extents, and claimants, which falls squarely under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
